item_foraging_knife.name: foraging knife
item_foraging_knife.description: A small, stout knife for cutting herbs and gathering plants without damaging their roots.

item_hand_axe.name: hand axe
item_hand_axe.description: A compact woodcutter's axe, useful for trimming fallen branches and light chopping.

item_prospector_pick.name: prospector's pick
item_prospector_pick.description: A modest pick for loosening ore and prying crystals from exposed stone.

item_lockpick.name: iron lockpick
item_lockpick.description: A thin piece of iron shaped to manipulate tumbler locks. It looks brittle.

item_master_lockpick.name: masterwork lockpick
item_master_lockpick.description: A finely crafted lockpick made of flexible steel. Much harder to break.

item_lockpick_crude_bronze.name: crude bronze lockpick
item_lockpick_crude_bronze.description: A hastily cast bronze pick. Soft metal; it won't take much abuse.

item_lockpick_crude_steel.name: crude steel lockpick
item_lockpick_crude_steel.description: A roughly filed steel pick. Not pretty, but sturdier than bronze.

item_lockpick_fine_bronze.name: fine bronze lockpick
item_lockpick_fine_bronze.description: A carefully shaped bronze pick with a well-balanced tension bar.

item_lockpick_fine_steel.name: fine steel lockpick
item_lockpick_fine_steel.description: A precisely tempered steel pick, built to take a beating without snapping.

item_lockpick_shiv.name: makeshift shiv
item_lockpick_shiv.description: A sliver of scavenged metal, bent and sharpened by hand. Not much, but it might just work.
